# Architecture Recommendation

**Use a self-hosted open-source stack on a single cloud VM (AWS EC2 t3.medium or equivalent)** running Docker containers with PostgreSQL, Node.js/Python backend, and React frontend, deployed via GitHub Actions CI/CD—this keeps costs under $50/month while leveraging the team's deployment experience and ensuring maintainability through Infrastructure-as-Code practices.

**Alternative for higher availability:** Deploy across two t3.small instances with a load balancer and managed PostgreSQL (RDS free tier eligible), staying well under the $500 budget while providing redundancy and easier maintenance.

Both approaches use only free/low-cost open-source tools (Docker, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL, Linux) and avoid any paid SaaS dependencies.
